content.comment_body: Hello, I've noticed that the [product_name] module has different [article_no] numbers depending on the revision: • [article_no] for [product_name] version 6/7 • [article_no] for [product_name] version 8 Is it possible to exchange these? For example, can the first module be used with [product_name] version 8 and the second with version 6/7? I checked datasheets for both [article_no], but didn't find compatibility information. Thanks for your assistance.

No, that’s not possible. The controllers and expansion modules from series 8 feature completely new hardware and aren’t compatible with earlier series. You cannot combine any expansion modules from previous versions with the series 8 controller. Likewise, series 8 expansion modules are incompatible with controllers from earlier versions. The extension modules from series 8 also can't be mixed with those from previous versions. [url]
That's exactly what I needed to know. Thank you.
